title: Canned goods pallets quoted class 70 instead of 65
text: Hartline's LTL buyer is asking why our quotes on their canned goods pallets keep coming back at class 70 when every other carrier quotes class 65. I checked one: quote Q-55871, a 48x40x50 pallet at 1,350 lb, which works out to 24.30 pcf. That should be class 65 (22.5 to 30 pcf), but we quote class 70, and the class 70 rate is about 9% higher. They ship 60 to 80 of these pallets a week, so we are losing the business on price. Anything between 22.5 and 25 pcf seems to come out one class too high. Classing happens in `class_for_pallet` in `freight_class.py`.
